post.caption:
The Arctic tern flies around 70,000 km a year, pole to pole, for about 30 years. Monarchs complete their migration across generations. Bar-tailed godwits fly 11 days without landing. Salmon return to the exact stream they hatched in. The distance is not the real question. Navigation is.
